Porsche Little Rock is delighted to showcase, this Pre-Owned 2014 Porsche Cayman S. Dressed in a refined Agate Grey Metallic exterior and with 84,247 miles to its name, this Cayman S captures the spirit of a mid-engine sports car with Porsches signature driving dynamics and design language.

Step inside the Leather Package in Agate Grey/Amber Orange and discover an interior designed around the driver. Equipped with Power Sport Seats (14-way) with Memory Package, Seat Heating and Ventilation (Front), 2-zone automatic air conditioning, and the SportDesign Steering Wheel, comfort and control are perfectly balanced.

Engine and Performance: This Cayman S is powered by a 3.4 liter flat-six engine generating 325 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) transmission.
